privacy_section_2_body: Protecting your personal data is important to us. Processing is carried out in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable German data protection laws.
privacy_section_3_body:
When using the app, the following data may be collected and processed:
• Email address
• Username and profile information
• Listing content and uploaded images
• Messages between users
• Technical data (device type, operating system, IP address, usage data)
privacy_section_4_body:
Your data is processed for:
• Providing app features
• Managing user accounts
• Publishing and displaying listings
• Communication between users
• Improving and securing the platform
privacy_section_5_body: Processing is carried out in accordance with Article 6(1)(b) GDPR (performance of contract) and Article 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest in providing a secure and functional platform).
privacy_section_6_body: Personal data will only be shared with third parties if necessary for the technical provision of the app (e.g. hosting or cloud service providers) or if required by law.
privacy_section_7_body: Personal data is stored only as long as necessary for the respective purposes or as required by statutory retention obligations.
privacy_section_8_body:
You have the right to:
• Access your stored data
• Rectify incorrect data
• Delete your data
• Restrict processing
• Data portability
• Withdraw consent
To exercise your rights, contact: laeno.app@gmail.com
privacy_section_9_body: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data from loss, manipulation, or unauthorized access.
privacy_section_10_body: We reserve the right to amend this privacy policy when necessary. The current version always applies.
